both_families_have_feature_level_data.evidence: RNA+protein retains RNA/ADT matrices; P22 retains RNA and 121068-peak ATAC matrices

rna_protein_auditable_feature_correspond.evidence: 29/31 deposited ADT target names exactly match RNA gene symbols in A1/tonsil/D1; two unresolved targets were not guessed

rna_atac_genome_build_and_peak_gene_evid.evidence: 121027/121068 peak identifiers contain parseable intervals, but no authoritative genome build, peak-gene link, gene activity annotation, or traceable generator exists

three_way_object_observable_sparse_and_l.evidence: bootstrap and spatial evidence are sparse-computable, but linked-feature evidence is unavailable for RNA+ATAC

distinct_from_spamv_spamode_candies_qmf_.evidence: requires independent stability, spatial reproducibility and linked-feature observations rather than a gate, MoE, shared/private split or conditional denoiser

unused_unit_exists_in_each_family.rna_protein: GSE198353 and some registered units were not used for the Night11A formula
unused_unit_exists_in_each_family.rna_atac: P22 is the only audited RNA+ATAC biological unit and was used in Night11A formula design

no_dataset_name_routing_labels_or_dense_.evidence: a future implementation can use explicit assay-family contracts and sparse matrices; no label dependence is mathematically required

minimum_scope_expansion.rna_atac: one annotated discovery unit plus one untouched confirmatory slice/dataset with raw counts, coordinates, genome build and reproducible peak-gene evidence
minimum_scope_expansion.rna_protein: authoritative GSE198353 ADT-to-gene mapping and an approved confirmation boundary; add an untouched slice if prior preflight disqualifies replicate 2
